DXP is the main resource in the game.
The tetris game should provide large amounts of DXP when a line is cleared but should not punish if you "game over" as I want the player to be allowed to use other upgrade games while playing.

The blocks should only be 1x1 and come in multiple colors.

The game should not extend past the existing bounds of the two buttons and background sprites.

Please don't use the green flag, use _startHungrydemons instead.
